g.text: N16 | A three-layer development site passes the fixed gate
All 31 nonempty subsets of layers 5 to 9 are retained. No singleton or pair passes; five triples do.
Orange: selected layers 5, 6, 9 by fewest layers then lexicographic order. Selection does not use the highest score.
Dotted cutoffs: transfer at least 8; preservation at least 14. Coverage and all eight retention cases also required.
N16: 1,880 audited records, 1,680 new and 200 carried. Parent single-layer, adjacent-pair and full-block results are closed.
Zero training. Reused development; conditional donor sufficiency, not individual neuron meaning, formal synergy or coding improvement.
